choice: 404 NOT_FOUND (unknown /api path, missing or blocked static file), 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with an Allow header, 413 BODY_TOO_LARGE; malformed JSON body is 400 INPUT
text: Which code values do HTTP-level errors that have no shared error class use?
why: types.js only defines codes for INPUT, TRIP_TOO_LONG, NO_ROUTE, UPSTREAM; these keep every error in the same {error, code} shape
